title: MTC CA Operational ARI Test Report Schema
description: Schema for reporting quarterly operational ACME Renewal Information (ARI) client responsiveness test cycles.

test_cycle_id.description: Unique identifier for this operational ARI test cycle (e.g., 2026-Q3-ARI-TEST-01).

sample_selection.description: Metadata regarding the derivation of the sample population.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp when sample selection occurred.

methodology_description.description: Detailed human-readable explanation of sample selection methodology.

filter_criteria.description: Criteria used to filter the eligible certificate population.

selection_algorithm.description: Random selection algorithm or mechanism used to collect the sample.

eligible_certificate_count.description: Total count of eligible certificates meeting sample criteria.

sampled_certificate_count.description: Total count of certificates selected for sampling.

sample_percentage.description: Percentage of eligible certificates sampled (MUST be at least 3.0%).

summary.description: Aggregate summary statistics for the test cycle.

overall_pass_rate_percentage.description: Overall percentage of sampled certificates that passed the ARI test.

median_time_to_renewal_seconds.description: Median time to renewal in seconds for successful test cases.

p95_time_to_renewal_seconds.description: 95th percentile time to renewal in seconds for successful test cases.

user_agent_version_breakdown.description: Pass/fail breakdown by parsed client software name and version.

results.description: Individual test results for every sampled certificate.

serial_number.description: Hex-encoded serial number of the sampled certificate.

issuance_log_entry_index.description: Issuance Log Entry Index for the sampled certificate.

user_agent.description: Full untruncated HTTP User-Agent request header string.

renewal_timestamp.description: UTC timestamp of renewal for successful tests, or null if failed.

time_to_renewal_seconds.description: Calculated time to renewal in seconds relative to the start of the ARI window for successful tests, or null if failed.
